facts.text: The hotel anchors Old Town Scottsdale's Entertainment District, with bars, restaurants and nightclubs steps away.
facts.excerpt: Anchoring Old Town’s Entertainment District, our hotel places you at the center of Scottsdale’s fashion, art, live music, and nightlife, with over 100 bars, restaurants, and nightclubs steps away.

facts.text: The Scottsdale Waterfront is two blocks from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located two blocks from our hotel in Old Town Scottsdale with a pool, the Scottsdale Waterfront

facts.text: The Camelback Mountain hiking trails are two miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Soak up views of Camelback Mountain from your hotel room before you hike the trails two miles away

facts.text: Guests can browse the Fifth Avenue shops and Native American jewelry in Historic Old Town.
facts.excerpt: Spend the day browsing the Fifth Avenue shops, trying on Native American jewelry in Historic Old Town

facts.text: Rooms have vibrant decor and ceiling-high windows with sweeping views of the Sonoran Desert.
facts.excerpt: Surround yourself with vibrant décor and ceiling-high windows with sweeping views of the Sonoran Desert.

facts.text: Loft-inspired suites have full kitchens and views of the hotel's zen garden.
facts.excerpt: Ask about our loft-inspired hotel suites in Scottsdale for full kitchens with overhead cabinets and views of the hotel's zen garden.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suites measure 2,100 square feet and are the hotel's most expansive.
facts.excerpt: Our 2,100 sq. ft. Penthouse Suites are our most expansive.

facts.text: Penthouse Suite views can include Camelback Mountain, the Entertainment District and the WET Deck.
facts.excerpt: Views can include Camelback Mountain, Entertainment District and WET Deck.

facts.text: In a Deluxe Spa Suite, AWAY Spa brings treatments to the room, and its centerpiece is a soaking spa tub.
facts.excerpt: AWAY® Spa will bring the pampering right to your room. Bubble away 24-7 in the privacy of this spa room's centerpiece, a luxurious soaking spa tub.

facts.text: The WET Deck has an outdoor pool and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Our WET Deck, with outdoor pool and cabanas, has a summertime atmosphere year-round

facts.text: The WET Deck hosts day club pool events every Friday to Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Our iconic WET Deck hosts our day club pool events every Friday - Sunday!

facts.text: WET Deck pool events feature music from resident DJs.
facts.excerpt: We make a splash with pulsating music with resident DJs at our hotel in Old Town Scottsdale, AZ.

facts.text: AWAY Spa is a wellness and beauty spa offering a rejuvenating and detoxifying experience.
facts.excerpt: AWAY Spa is a wellness and beauty sanctuary offering guests a rejuvenating and detoxifying spa experience.

facts.text: AWAY Spa has seven treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: the seven treatment rooms at our hotel spa in Scottsdale allow flexibility to fit your schedule

facts.text: With Spa After Dark, groups can rent out AWAY Spa for a night with a live DJ and face, beauty and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: Rent out the AWAY® Spa for a night of over-the-top pampering. Set the mood with a live DJ, bottomless bubbly and indulge in face, beauty and body treatments.

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers Aescape robotic massages.
facts.excerpt: Experience the future of relaxation with Aescape's AI-driven robotic technology.

facts.text: Sexy Roman is the hotel's Italian restaurant, blending Italian cuisine with immersive design.
facts.excerpt: our destination Italian restaurant in downtown Scottsdale, Sexy Roman blends luxurious Italian cuisine with immersive design and unforgettable energy.

facts.text: The rooftop Cottontail Lounge sits next to the WET Deck on the second floor, with craft cocktails and sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Located adjacent to the WET Deck on the 2nd floor, the rooftop Cottontail Lounge offers bold vibes, craft cocktails and a fun, flirty atmosphere. Enjoy sunset views

facts.text: Every room features Davines bath products and Comfort Zone soaps and lotions.
facts.excerpt: Every room at W Scottsdale features Davines bath products and Comfort Zone soaps and lotions.

facts.text: Pets are welcome and receive a W Hotels pet bed, treat and water bowl.
facts.excerpt: an exclusive W Hotels pet bed, treat and water bowl

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: The WET Deck is an adult environment for guests 21 and over only.
facts.excerpt: WET Deck is an adult environment for 21+ only.

facts.text: WET Deck lounge chairs fill up quickly and seating is not guaranteed for all hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Lounge chairs fill up quickly and seating is not guaranteed for all hotel guests.

facts.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 10 miles and roughly 20 minutes' drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport which is 10 miles from our hotel and approximately 20 minutes in drive time

facts.text: With scenic trails at the doorstep, guests can explore Scottsdale by bike.
facts.excerpt: With scenic trails at our doorstep, two wheels is a great way to explore the surrounding Scottsdale city and terrain.
